notes.title: New Trailer
notes.notes:
Hey everybody

You can now find a first small gameplay trailer on the store page. It's still alpha material but it should give you a good idea of the movement.

Let us know what you think in the comments or in our [url=https://discord.gg/Rtq7usp]Discord[/url]
Thanks

notes.title: WEJAM is released on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello there

We just released WEJAM this week on Steam. You can grab it with a nice 33% launch sale and start making music with some strangers online.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094110/WEJAM/

notes.title: Zurich Game Show 2019
notes.notes: This year we were at the Zurich Game Show presenting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094110?snr=2_9_100000_]WEJAM[/url] and a first prototype of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140390/Hyperspeed_Fragfest/]Hyperspeed Fragfest[/url] to the public. The feedback was great, meeting the community and other game developers is always extremely inspiring. Thanks to everybody who played our games. See you all next year!
